$comment: Provenance for every pair in coordinates.json. A coordinate with no
source is indistinguishable from a guess six months later, and this
dataset's posture is that 'we checked' must be checkable.
'legacy-production' marks the nine that were moved from engagedmoon's
own copy on 2026-08-07. They were live and computing correct sunset
windows, but the URL they were originally read from was not recorded.
Re-source them opportunistically; do not delete them.
